lastGame.title: Bills 33, Raiders 30
stats: Josh Allen: 255 pass yds, 2 TD — his 258th career TD pass ties Jim Kelly's Bills record
James Cook: 22 carries, 95 yds, TD + 3 catches for 58 yds
TD catches for Keon Coleman (shovel pass) and Khalil Shakir (9-yd screen)
Dorian Williams: first career interception, off Kirk Cousins
Tyler Bass 38-yd FG made it 33-23; Bills recovered the onside kick to close it

news.h: Gardner-Johnson fined on top of ban
news.b: The NFL fined C.J. Gardner-Johnson $11,194 for unnecessary roughness against the Raiders, on top of his upheld one-game suspension for spitting. He will sit out the Ravens game on Nov. 1.

Safety Sam Franklin also drew a one-game ban for allegedly spitting toward a Raiders player; he and his agent deny it, and his appeal is set to be heard by former player James Thrash with no ruling date yet.

news.h: Lamar Jackson 'day to day' before Buffalo
news.b: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson has missed two games with an ankle injury and was limited in practice midweek; coach Jesse Minter calls him day to day. Baltimore hosted Cincinnati on Sunday (Oct. 25) and comes to Orchard Park next, then hosts Jacksonville on Thursday, Nov. 5.

news.h: Tough road ahead after the bye
news.b: Buffalo leads the NFL in scoring but ranks 31st in yards allowed and faces the fourth-toughest remaining schedule. The Jets (2-4) host winless Miami on Sunday while the Bills (5-1) sit on a game-and-a-half AFC East lead.

source: Heavy (Oct 22–24), Yahoo Sports/Bills On SI (Oct 24), ESPN odds and schedule; checked Oct 25, 2026. Refreshes with the daily update.
